reasons.dead|aside.data-methodology-rail: The methodology rail is a sticky rail beside the audit ledger, not a card: `align-self: start` and `position: sticky; top: 24px` from 880px, so it stays beside the reader while the long evidence table scrolls under it. Measured at 880px the rail's own box is 928px tall inside a 3121px row, and the column beside it is 2193px taller. The space below the rail is the audit's length, not a hole in the rail.
reasons.dead|aside.pom-bio-aside: Uncle Pom's bio is a bordered aside in a two-column dossier layout (`align-self: start`), so it is the height of its own content and the essay beside it is the taller column. Measured at 880px the aside is 240px tall in a 511px row, and the 271px under it is the essay's column, which continues past the aside by exactly that much.
reasons.dead|div.market-toggle: The market toggle is baseline-aligned with a section heading that wraps to three lines at this width (`align-items: baseline`). Measured at 481px the heading is 100.8px tall and the toggle 22px, so the 79px under the toggle is the heading's own last line. The toggle belongs to the first line, where the reader's eye already is.
reasons.dead|div.vc-specs: The venue card's specification rows (venue role, fee evidence) sit under the card header, and the card's height is set by the header's wrapped address beside it. Measured at 759px the 75.5px below the spec block is the card's own air above the visit link, and the card's border is the ledger's rule, not a frame drawn around a hole.
reasons.dead|p: The screen card's description paragraph is followed by the status note and the action row, both pinned to the card's foot by `margin-top: auto`, so the rows stay equal height and the ledger's rules stay straight across all three columns. Measured at 919px the paragraph ends 216px above the action row. That gap is the slack between this card's text and the longest description in its row.
reasons.dead|p.guide-card-subtitle: The guide card's reading time and its call to action are pinned to the card's foot (`margin-top: auto` on `.guide-card-mins`), and the three guide cards are one ruled row of three - coral, yellow, navy - so their heights are equal and the row's black rules stay straight. Measured at 1099px the subtitle ends 138.1px above the pinned reading time; that gap is the card's air, and it is the same in all three cards, which is what makes the row read as one composition.
reasons.dead|span.asia-spotlight-all-body: The spotlight is a navy plate whose link is pinned to its foot (`margin-top: auto`), so the plate reads as a block of colour with its statement at the top and its way on at the bottom. Measured at 920px the body ends 161.6px above the pinned link. That space is inside a deliberately coloured block, and the block is the palette's counter-field.
reasons.dead|span.vc-type-tag.mono: The venue-type badge is a top-aligned marker in the card header row (`align-items: flex-start`), level with the first line of the venue name beside it. Measured at 718px the badge is 14px tall and the header row is 116px because the name and country wrap to three lines. The 102px under the badge is the card's own air, and a badge hung at the foot of the row would read as belonging to the spec table instead of to the name.
reasons.orphan|aside.wmp-time-rail: The watchmaking timeline rail is a sticky rail, not a panel: it is `position: sticky; top: calc(var(--header-h) + 120px)` with `align-self: start` and `max-height: calc(100vh - ...); overflow-y: auto`, so the reader scrolls the rail itself and it never leaves the viewport. Measured at 1101px it fills 12% of a 6075px row because the timeline beside it is 6075px long. The rail is the timeline's column, not 6075px of nothing.
reasons.orphan|div.pom-card-image: The dossier card is two columns: the object image on the left and the dossier body on the right. The image column is `align-self: start`, so it is as tall as the photograph and the body's own text is what makes the card 709px tall. Measured at 720px the image column fills 17% of that row because the body beside it is 590px of written dossier. The card is not short; the picture is.
reasons.scattered|div.guides-grid: The three guide cards are one ruled row of three - coral, yellow, navy - so their centres sit at 1/6, 1/2 and 5/6 of the row. Measured at 879px two of the cards' centres are 67% of the row's WIDTH apart. The instrument measures the space BETWEEN cells, and in a three-cell row that space is the column, not a scatter.
reasons.dead|p.screen-rights.mono: The screen card's rights line is followed by the status note and the action row, which are pinned to the card's foot so the ledger's rows stay equal height. Measured at 1099px the rights line ends 78.4px above the note. The card's own text is shorter than the tallest card in its row, and the row's height is a decision about the table, not about this card.
